verdict.rationale: Autumn exposes a broad programmatic surface. The API covers customers, attach/multi-attach, schedules, import, licenses, portal sessions, check/track and preview. Plans and features can be defined as code and pushed or pulled via the atmn CLI, including pulling dashboard-created products. An `atmn api` command calls any public endpoint, and the official MCP server covers billing, customer, plan, balance and log tools. No source explicitly claims full UI-to-API parity, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or audit of dashboard/API parity, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation that every dashboard action has an API equivalent.
